summary: Find the unique nonblack color occurring exactly four times on at most three rows and three columns. Draw a full line through every row and column containing exactly two target cells, clearing all distractors. When the four cells are rectangle corners, draw only its longer-axis pair: horizontal for a wider rectangle and vertical otherwise.
